title: Twin-Court Canon of Two Voices
summary: A canon of the twin court on two voices that answer one another in guard and strike, ending in a duet that sunders what it meets.

title: Hawk-Stoop Treatise of the Rending Cry
summary: A treatise on the cry of the stooping hawk drawn out to a point that tears, ending in a descent that rends guard and armor together.

title: Basin Court Manual of the Gathered Echo
summary: A manual on gathering every echo of the field into one body of sound and loosing it at once as a roar.

title: River-Run Canon of the Flowing Tone
summary: A canon of a tone that runs on without breaking like a river, mending in its shallows and sweeping in its flood.

title: Great Book of the Azure Resonant Bell
summary: The great book of the azure bell whose toll rekindles a faint life and in its closing stroke brings ruin to a wide field.

title: Oath-Book of the Held Drone
summary: An oath-book of the low drone held without a break for as long as the oath lasts, ending in a drone that presses a whole field to the ground.

title: Plateau Canon of the Sworn Roar
summary: A canon of the roar that is sworn before it is loosed and thunders only when the oath is called.

title: Treatise on the Bearing Taken in Sound
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing by sound and holding it so that every note goes exactly where it was set.

title: Unwalled Canon of the Wide Silence
summary: A canon of a silence that has no walls and spreads over the whole field and that swallows blows and voices alike.

title: Wind-Sworn Canon of the Last Echo
summary: A wind-sworn canon of the echo that is the last to die and of the closing strokes built on its fading.
